title: Numb Hands — Carpal Tunnel, Cubital Tunnel and the Neck

hook.en: Tingling hands at night are very common. Learn to tell carpal tunnel syndrome from an ulnar nerve problem or a neck cause, and when a hand needs a specialist.
hook.ur: Raat ko hathon mein jhunjhunahat bohat aam hai. Carpal tunnel syndrome ko ulnar nerve ke masle ya gardan ki wajah se alag karna seekhein, aur kab hath ko specialist chahiye.

goal.en: By the end, you'll map the numbness, use the hand diagram, Phalen, Tinel and the carpal compression test with their limits in mind, and decide between splinting, exercises and referral.
goal.ur: End tak aap sunn hone ka naqsha banayenge, hand diagram, Phalen, Tinel aur carpal compression test unki hadood ke saath istemal karenge, aur splint, exercises aur referral mein faisla karenge.

text.en: Ask **which fingers**. Thumb, index, middle and half of the ring finger point to the **median nerve at the wrist**; the little finger and the other half of the ring finger point to the **ulnar nerve at the elbow**. Numbness in the whole hand or the back of the hand, or pain from the neck, points elsewhere. Then ask about **night waking**, **shaking the hand** to relieve it and **dropping things**.
text.ur: Poochhein **kaun si ungliyan**. Anguthha, shahadat, beech ki ungli aur ring finger ka aadha hissa **kalai par median nerve** ki taraf; chhoti ungli aur ring finger ka doosra aadha hissa **kohni par ulnar nerve** ki taraf ishara karta hai. Poora hath ya hath ki pusht par sunn hona, ya gardan se dard kahin aur ishara karta hai. Phir **raat ko jaagne**, aaram ke liye **hath jhatakne** aur **cheezein girne** ke baare mein poochhein.

text.en: Think of the carpal tunnel as a narrow pipe holding nine tendons and one cable, the median nerve. Anything that crowds the pipe, such as swelling, a bent wrist at night or repeated gripping, squeezes the cable first. That is why bending the wrist (Phalen) can bring the tingling on, and why a neutral night splint helps.
text.ur: Carpal tunnel ko ek tang pipe samjhein jis mein nau tendons aur ek cable, median nerve, hai. Jo bhi cheez pipe ko bhar de, jaise sujan, raat ko mura hua kalai ya baar baar pakarna, woh sab se pehle cable ko dabati hai. Isi liye kalai mur kar (Phalen) jhunjhunahat aa sakti hai, aur neutral night splint madad karta hai.

title.ur: Hath ke sunn hone ki examination

steps.title: Map the symptoms
steps.detail: Use the hand diagram (the patient shades the numb areas) and ask about night waking and hand shaking. Median-nerve areas with night symptoms make carpal tunnel likely. || Alamaat ka naqsha banayein

steps.title: Look and feel the hand
steps.detail: Look for wasting of the thenar muscle at the base of the thumb and test thumb abduction strength and light touch in the median fingers. Thenar wasting means a longer, more severe compression. || Hath ko dekhein aur chhuein

steps.title: Provoke the nerve
steps.detail: Phalen's test (wrist bent for up to a minute), the carpal compression test (pressing over the tunnel) and Tinel's sign (tapping over the nerve). Use them together; none is enough alone. || Nerve ko provoke karein

steps.title: Check the neck and elbow
steps.detail: Test neck movement and the arm reflexes, and tap the ulnar nerve at the elbow. Pain from the neck or numbness in the little finger moves the problem away from the wrist. || Gardan aur kohni dekhein

question.en: Numbness in the thumb, index and middle fingers that wakes the patient at night and eases with shaking the hand. What is most likely?
question.ur: Anguthe, shahadat aur beech ki ungli mein sunn hona jo raat ko jagata hai aur hath jhatakne se kam hota hai. Sab se mumkin kya hai?

feedback.en: That affects the little and half the ring finger.
feedback.ur: Yeh chhoti aur ring finger ke aadhe hisse ko mutasir karta hai.

feedback.en: Yes — median nerve fingers, night symptoms and relief on shaking are the typical picture.
feedback.ur: Haan — median nerve ki ungliyan, raat ki alamaat aur jhatakne se aaram typical tasveer hai.

rows.ur: Anguthha, shahadat, beech, ring ka aadha

rows.ur: Chhoti aur ring ka aadha hissa

rows.en: Elbow bent for long, leaning on the elbow
rows.ur: Kohni der tak mudi hui, kohni par tekna

text.en: **Which fingers, which hour.** Median fingers and night waking suggest the wrist; the little finger suggests the elbow; the whole arm or neck pain suggests the neck. Map the symptoms before you test.
text.ur: **Kaun si ungliyan, kaun sa waqt.** Median ungliyan aur raat ko jagna kalai ki taraf, chhoti ungli kohni ki taraf, poora bazu ya gardan ka dard gardan ki taraf ishara karte hain. Test se pehle alamaat ka naqsha banayein.

text.en: **Relying on one test.** Phalen's and Tinel's tests each miss many people and each is positive in some people without the condition. A cluster of the hand diagram, night symptoms, sensory loss and a positive test is far more reliable.
text.ur: **Ek test par bharosa karna.** Phalen aur Tinel tests har ek bohat se logon ko miss karte hain aur kuch bina bimari ke bhi positive hote hain. Hand diagram, raat ki alamaat, hiss ka kam hona aur ek positive test ka majmua kahin zyada bharosemand hai.

question.en: Which finding means the compression has been going on for a long time?
question.ur: Kaun si finding batati hai ke dabao der se chal raha hai?

feedback.en: It does not show how long or how severe.
feedback.ur: Yeh nahi batata ke kitni der ya kitna shadeed.

text.en: Wasting of the thenar muscle with weak thumb abduction
text.ur: Thenar muscle ka sukharna aur anguthe ki kamzor abduction

feedback.en: Yes — muscle wasting is a late sign and needs a specialist opinion.
feedback.ur: Haan — muscle ka sukharna dair se aane wali nishani hai aur specialist ki raaye maangta hai.

question.en: Numbness only in the little finger and half of the ring finger, worse after leaning on the elbow. Where is the problem most likely?
question.ur: Sirf chhoti ungli aur ring finger ke aadhe hissay mein sunn hona, kohni par tekne ke baad zyada. Masla sab se mumkin kahan hai?

text.en: At the elbow, the ulnar nerve in the cubital tunnel
text.ur: Kohni par, cubital tunnel mein ulnar nerve

feedback.en: Yes — these fingers and the elbow trigger point to the ulnar nerve.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh ungliyan aur kohni ka trigger ulnar nerve ki taraf ishara karte hain.

feedback.en: That does not explain the finger pattern.
feedback.ur: Yeh ungliyon ka pattern nahi samjhata.

text.en: At the wrist, the median nerve

feedback.en: The median nerve supplies the thumb side.
feedback.ur: Median nerve anguthe ki taraf hiss deta hai.

text.en: **Splint, advise, review.** For mild to moderate carpal tunnel, a neutral wrist night splint for several weeks, changes to repeated gripping and nerve gliding are sensible. Review in four to six weeks; if there is no change, or if there is wasting or constant numbness, refer for assessment.
text.ur: **Splint, mashwara, review.** Halke se darmiyane carpal tunnel mein kai hafton ke liye neutral kalai night splint, baar baar pakarne mein tabdeeli aur nerve gliding munasib hain. Chaar se chhe hafte mein review karein; tabdeeli na ho, ya sukharna ya musalsal sunn hona ho to assessment ke liye refer karein.

question.en: Why is a positive Phalen's test not enough to diagnose carpal tunnel syndrome?
question.ur: Positive Phalen test carpal tunnel syndrome ki diagnosis ke liye kaafi kyun nahi?

answer.en: Because the test is positive in a fair number of people who do not have the condition and negative in many who do. The diagnosis is more reliable when the hand diagram, the night symptoms, any sensory loss and the test results all point the same way.
answer.ur: Kyunke yeh test un bohat se logon mein bhi positive hota hai jinhein yeh bimari nahi, aur bohat se mareezon mein negative. Diagnosis zyada bharosemand hoti hai jab hand diagram, raat ki alamaat, hiss ki kami aur test ke nateeje ek hi taraf ishara karein.

beats.patient: A 45-year-old tailor has tingling in the right thumb, index and middle fingers, waking him at night and easing when he shakes his hand. The hand diagram shades the median area, Phalen's test is positive and there is no neck pain or thenar wasting.
beats.assessment: The picture fits mild to moderate carpal tunnel syndrome with no sign of a neck cause or long-standing compression.
beats.treatment: Fit a neutral night splint, adjust his gripping and stitching positions, teach nerve glides and review in six weeks.
beats.reassess: After six weeks the night waking has stopped and the tingling occurs only after long sewing; he continues the plan.

text.en: **Refer promptly** for thenar wasting, constant numbness, weakness that is getting worse, symptoms in both arms with neck pain or weakness in the legs (possible cord or neck cause), a sudden painful, swollen, numb hand, or numbness after a wrist fracture or injury.
text.ur: **Jald refer karein** thenar sukharna, musalsal sunn hona, barhti hui kamzori, dono bazuon mein alamaat gardan ke dard ya taangon ki kamzori ke saath (mumkin cord ya gardan ki wajah), achanak dardnak sooja sunn hath, ya kalai ki fracture ya chot ke baad sunn hona.

summary.en: Map the numbness first: median fingers and night waking point to the wrist, the little finger to the elbow and whole-arm symptoms to the neck.
summary.ur: Pehle sunn hone ka naqsha banayein: median ungliyan aur raat ko jagna kalai ki taraf, chhoti ungli kohni ki taraf aur poore bazu ki alamaat gardan ki taraf ishara karte hain.

summary.en: Use Phalen, Tinel and carpal compression together with the hand diagram; no single test is enough.
summary.ur: Hand diagram ke saath Phalen, Tinel aur carpal compression milakar istemal karein; koi ek test kaafi nahi.

summary.en: Mild to moderate cases do well with a neutral night splint, changes to gripping and nerve glides; thenar wasting or constant numbness needs referral.
summary.ur: Halke se darmiyane kes neutral night splint, pakarne mein tabdeeli aur nerve glides se achhe hote hain; thenar sukharna ya musalsal sunn hona referral maangta hai.

front.en: Which fingers does the median nerve supply sensation to?
front.ur: Median nerve kin ungliyon ko hiss deta hai?

back.en: Thumb, index, middle and half of the ring finger.
back.ur: Anguthha, shahadat, beech ki aur ring finger ka aadha hissa.

front.ur: Thenar sukharna kis ki taraf ishara karta hai?

back.en: A long-standing or severe median nerve compression.
back.ur: Median nerve ka purana ya shadeed dabao.

front.en: Why is a neutral night splint useful?
front.ur: Neutral night splint kyun mufeed hai?

back.en: It keeps the wrist from bending, so the tunnel stays open during sleep.
back.ur: Yeh kalai ko mudne se rokta hai, is liye neend mein tunnel khula rehta hai.

front.en: Which fingers suggest the ulnar nerve?
front.ur: Kaun si ungliyan ulnar nerve ki taraf ishara karti hain?

back.en: The little finger and half of the ring finger.
back.ur: Chhoti ungli aur ring finger ka aadha hissa.

note.en: Practise Phalen, Tinel and the other wrist and hand tests.
note.ur: Phalen, Tinel aur kalai aur hath ke doosray tests practise karein.

note.en: How nerve gliding is chosen and taught safely.
note.ur: Nerve gliding kaise chuni aur mehfooz tareeqe se sikhayi jati hai.
